diagnosis.cause: The `node:19` Docker image does not include Deno; README.md:579 documents `deno add axios` but Deno must be installed first, producing exit code 127 (`deno: command not found`).

actions.command: curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh && export DENO_INSTALL="$HOME/.deno" && export PATH="$DENO_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"

doc.text: Before running `deno add axios`, install Deno: `curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh` and add `$HOME/.deno/bin` to your PATH.

fix.log:
$ curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh && export DENO_INSTALL="$HOME/.deno" && export PATH="$DENO_INSTALL/bin:$PATH" → exit 35
